passive verb modified by the opening manner phrase

words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) does not open with a new actor or a causal explanation; it launches a likeness-and-manner frame. Bound to {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}), it makes the ayah answer the prior diversion question as a recognizable pattern before the deniers are named. The compressed fronted phrase lets {{ar:يُؤْفَكُ}} ({{tr:yuʾfaku}}) arrive as a rule-like passive verdict rather than an isolated report.

topics.headline: likeness frames the passive verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening marks how diversion happens, through likeness to an already displayed pattern rather than a fresh causal explanation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support {{ar:كَذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:kadhālika}}) as the comparative manner complement for the passive verb.

topics.headline: fronted phrase answers the prior question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with the rule-answer, so the passive verb is heard through pattern recognition before the affected group appears.
topics.reason: The fronted comparative expression precedes its verbal domain and continues the immediately preceding diversion wording.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative functioning as the reference point governed by the prefixed comparative particle
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) supplies the reference point inside the opening {{ar:كَذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:kadhālika}}). Its distal force makes the pattern recognizable yet held at diagnostic distance: the listener is asked to view the process before the ayah names the class who instantiate it. Across the boundary, the how-question in 40:62 becomes a demonstrative answer in 40:63.

topics.headline: distal pointer supplies the comparison object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah points to a recognizable pattern of diversion instead of introducing an undefined object.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is governed by the comparative particle and forms the manner phrase attached to the passive verb.

topics.headline: how-question becomes thus-answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cross-ayah movement from the question of how they are diverted (40:62) to the demonstrative answer in this opening.
topics.reason: The supplied boundary evidence supports a concrete 40:62 to 40:63 question-answer relation without making the demonstrative a separate object of belief.

words.gloss_range: Form IV passive imperfect: being turned away or inverted in a caused passive pattern without naming the agent
words.root_gloss_range: turning, inversion, overturning, and falsehood; local form selects passive misdirection while retaining truth-inversion pressure

words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْفَكُ}} ({{tr:yuʾfaku}}) is the ayah's passive verdict: the affected class is presented as being turned, while the turner remains unnamed. Because the root {{ar:أ ف ك}} ({{tr:ʾ-f-k}}) carries inversion and falsehood pressure, the turning is not mild relocation but truth-orientation reversed. The imperfect Form IV keeps that caused misdirection as a recurring pattern in a marked passive-diversion register, and 51:9 shows the broader formula of being turned from truth. Here its return from 40:62 shifts the prior direct challenge into a third-person classification answered by the final active denial.

topics.headline: passive verdict with unnamed turner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah diagnoses the deniers as patients of a caused turning without naming the external agent.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the verb as Form IV passive imperfect with an unresolved implicit agent and later passive subject.

topics.headline: turning carries truth-inversion pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive turning is evaluative: denial of signs becomes a reversal of truth-orientation, not a neutral shift.
topics.reason: The inversion and falsehood field survives as local pressure, while the passive Form IV blocks replacing the verb with an active liar-label or a separate polemical action.

topics.headline: imperfect Form IV marks recurring caused misdirection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb presents a recurrent passive process within a marked passive-diversion register rather than a one-time completed event.
topics.reason: The imperfect passive Form IV is locally selected, and contextual data marks this exact root-form as low-occurrence and passive-diversion oriented.

topics.headline: opening passive answered by closing active denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their passive condition is interpreted through their own sustained active denial at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The main passive verb opens the clause, and the relative clause closes on the active denial predicate for the same class.

topics.headline: previous challenge becomes verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root reprise from 40:62 to 40:63 turns direct address into a classified verdict, with 51:9 showing the broader passive-diversion formula.
topics.reason: The concrete boundary evidence supports the 40:62 to 40:63 reprise, and 51:9 is a valid parallel for the passive-diversion formula without overriding the local parse.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) arrives after the passive verb as the affected subject, so the event of being turned is heard before the class becomes visible. As a plural relative head, it does not label the group by tribe or rank; it waits for {{ar:كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:kānū bi-ʾāyāti allāhi yajḥadūn}}) to define them. Agreement then keeps the same class present through the auxiliary and final denial verb, with the long-vowel handoff into {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) making the relative clause feel continuous rather than abrupt.

topics.headline: postposed subject lets the event lead
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive event leads and the affected class is named only afterward.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the relative pronoun as the explicit passive subject of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: identity is supplied by the denial clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is not incidental description; the following relative clause defines the class being turned.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun requires the following relative content, and the auxiliary-denial predicate supplies that content.

topics.headline: plural agreement binds the class across the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural class is carried from the relative head through the auxiliary and final verb.
topics.reason: Plural morphology and subject agreement route the later verbal forms back to the relative head.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural auxiliary governing the following imperfect predicate and forming a habitual past characterization
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, occurrence, and state; local construction selects durative auxiliary force rather than independent existence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect denial predicate governed by the auxiliary

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) recruits being-language as aspect: it governs the later {{ar:يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yajḥadūn}}), even with the divine-sign phrase between them. The perfect auxiliary plus imperfect predicate makes denial a settled, continuing profile, not one completed refusal; unlike the instant realization pattern of 36:82, this root is stretched into habitual realization of refusal. Its plural marking and long ū also anticipate the final -ūna ending of {{ar:يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yajḥadūn}}), binding duration-marker and denial action across the intervening signs. That time-thick characterization explains why the opening passive verdict belongs to this class.

topics.headline: auxiliary makes denial habitual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is framed as a sustained habit rather than a single rejected sign.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary governs the imperfect denial predicate and creates a habitual past construction.

topics.headline: sign phrase sits inside the habitual predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence-field is embedded inside the characterization that defines the group.
topics.reason: The governed predicate is separated from the auxiliary by the prepositional sign phrase, but local syntax keeps the construction unified.

topics.headline: being-root sharpens settled moral profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the common being-root is locally narrowed into a state of practiced refusal.
topics.reason: The broader root range survives only through the selected auxiliary construction; independent existence, instant creation, or status nouns do not govern the local sense.

topics.headline: perfect plus imperfect contrasts other realizations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not instant realization as in 36:82, but a stretched realization of denial as a settled habit.
topics.reason: The 36:82 contrast is useful only as a root-range contrast; the local perfect auxiliary plus imperfect predicate controls the meaning here.

topics.headline: plural marking binds auxiliary to final verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural class remains audible from the auxiliary through the final denial verb.
topics.reason: Plural agreement and the shared verbal profile keep the relative subject active across the intervening evidence phrase.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition governing the signs noun and marking the object-domain or contact sphere of denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: signs noun governed by the prefixed preposition
denial verb to which the prepositional phrase attaches

words.prose: {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is the hinge that fastens the habitual refusal to its evidence-field. It governs {{ar:ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:ʾāyāti}}) and attaches the phrase to {{ar:يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yajḥadūn}}), so denial is not left abstract. Because the prepositional object comes before the final verb, the signs and their source are already in view when refusal is named.

topics.headline: preposition marks the evidence-domain of denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is directed against a governed field of signs, not left as a vague attitude.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) phrase as the prepositional object-domain of the denial verb.

topics.headline: evidence arrives before the denial verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause moves from duration into concrete signs before naming the act of denial.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the final predicate and is bound into the sign-source construction.

words.gloss_range: plural construct noun governed by the preposition and governing the divine name; signs, proofs, verses, and warning indicators remain locally available
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, indicator, proof, wonder, verse, with disputed return or seeking pressure; local phrase selects divine indicators as the denial field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prefixed preposition governing the signs noun
divine name completing the construct phrase

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:ʾāyāti}}) is pulled in two grammatical directions at once: governed by {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) as the domain of denial and governing {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) as construct head. The plural construct makes the evidence multiple and already attributed to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) before the final verb lands. Its lexical range keeps signs, proofs, wonders, verses, and warning-tokens in view, while the local construction narrows them into divine indicators being refused; those indicators are not inert objects but signs meant to orient recognition back to their source. The same denial-of-signs profile appears at 6:33, and 40:69 returns to the divine-sign phrase in dispute language.

topics.headline: signs are governed and source-bound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are simultaneously the governed domain of denial and the construct head bound to the divine name.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes {{ar:ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:ʾāyāti}}) both the prepositional complement of denial and the construct head before the divine name.

topics.headline: plural signs keep evidence multiple
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refused evidence is a range of divine indicators, not one undifferentiated item.
topics.reason: The plural noun and local denial construction support signs, proofs, verses, and warning indicators as the evidence-field without collapsing the range to only one sense.

topics.headline: signs carry orientation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are not inert objects; they function as indicators meant to orient recognition, while local grammar keeps the sign/proof sense primary.
topics.reason: The disputed return or seeking pressure survives as lexical coloring, but the local phrase selects the sign/proof field governed by denial.

topics.headline: recognized sign-denial profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is a recognizable Quranic profile of divine signs being denied, with 6:33 as a concrete parallel.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and parallel evidence support the denial-of-signs profile without inventing a new local syntax.

topics.headline: specified evidence precedes final denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final denial lands only after the evidence and its divine source have already been specified, with 40:69 later shifting the same sign field into dispute.
topics.reason: The preposed divine-sign phrase fills the middle of the habitual clause before the final denial verb, and the supplied same-surah comparison is 40:69.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive as the second term of the construct phrase, specifying the source and possessor of the signs
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name connected with worship and devotion; local grammar selects the named divine source rather than a generic deity term

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final denial verb following the completed sign-source phrase

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the construct phrase, making the signs grammatically tied to the named divine source before denial is named. Its genitive case marks source and possession, while the proper name fixes the referent rather than leaving the evidence as anonymous religious data. The worship and devotion field behind the proper name makes the denied signs belong to worshipful authority, not merely to an abstract source label. The word's placement before {{ar:يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yajḥadūn}}) means the final refusal confronts a named divine source; 41:53 supplies the contrast of divine signs being shown, while 40:69 returns to the same divine-sign construction inside the surah.

topics.headline: divine name completes the sign-source construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied signs are grammatically sourced in the divine name before the final denial verb appears.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes the divine name the genitive second term completing the construct phrase.

topics.headline: proper name fixes the referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence is not generic sign-data; it belongs to the named divine referent.
topics.reason: The proper name and dominant divine referent are locally active; derivational material is limited to worship/devotion pressure behind the proper name.

topics.headline: worship field stands behind the source name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are tied to worshipful authority, while the local phrase still functions as a proper-name source construction.
topics.reason: Worship and devotion pressure may color the proper name, but the local syntax does not turn it into a generic deity noun or derivational argument.

topics.headline: named source precedes final refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb lands only after the object-domain has been fully specified as signs of the named divine source.
topics.reason: The sign-source construct is completed before the final denial predicate, sharpening responsibility at the close.

topics.headline: divine-sign construction recurs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this phrase participates in a strong divine-sign construction, with 41:53 as contrastive disclosure and 40:69 as same-surah return.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and echo rows support divine-sign cohesion, including concrete references 41:53 and 40:69.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect plural denial or repudiation, functioning as the predicate of the auxiliary and taking the signs through a prepositional object-domain
words.root_gloss_range: repudiation, denial, refusal to acknowledge, sometimes despite recognition; local form selects ongoing active sign-denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: auxiliary completed by the final denial predicate
preposition marking the object-domain of denial

words.prose: {{ar:يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yajḥadūn}}) closes the ayah by naming the class's own active posture. It completes {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) after the intervening sign phrase, so the final word is ongoing habitual denial, not a detached present action. Through the {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi-}})-marked object-domain, the verb is specialized as denial of divine signs rather than generic rejection. The root {{ar:ج ح د}} ({{tr:j-ḥ-d}}) keeps refusal of owed recognition in view, sharpened by 27:14, and its active plural form answers the opening passive: they are described as being turned, yet the ayah ends on what they persistently do. The relatively uncommon refusal root and final -ūna cadence make the deniers' ongoing action bear the ayah's closing explanatory weight.

topics.headline: final verb completes the habitual predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's last word resolves the delayed predicate and makes denial the final revealed component of identity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the final verb as the predicate governed by the auxiliary.

topics.headline: denial works against the governed signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is specialized locally as denial of divine signs rather than generic rejection.
topics.reason: The verb takes a {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi-}})-marked object-domain, and the supplied collocation evidence links this root with signs.

topics.headline: denial is refusal before evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not mere lack of information but refusal of recognition before signs, with 27:14 sharpening that pressure.
topics.reason: The known-evidence pressure survives as lexical and intertextual force, while the local text itself specifies the object-domain as signs of the named divine source.

topics.headline: active plural assigns responsibility at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers remain active agents at the ayah's close, even after being described passively at the opening.
topics.reason: The active imperfect plural keeps the relative class as the subject of the closing action and excludes passive denied-object framing.

topics.headline: imperfect form marks ongoing refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form describes repeated conduct that can define a class, not one completed refusal.
topics.reason: The imperfect predicate inside the auxiliary construction supports ongoing denial, with root-family profiles adding entrenched refusal pressure.

topics.headline: closing denial explains opening inversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the moral loop: passive inversion and active denial define the same class together.
topics.reason: The ayah opens with passive patienthood and closes with the same class's active refusal, so the final verb explains the opening condition.

topics.headline: rare refusal root carries final weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a relatively uncommon refusal lexeme bears the ayah's final explanatory and auditory weight.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks the exact root-form as low-occurrence locally, and the word's final position lets the refusal verb carry the closing weight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُؤْفَكُ is joined to آيات and the habitual denial in كَانُوا ... يَجْحَدُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible sign supplies orientation, while knowing denial refuses the direction already recognized. The passive turning names a reversal away from the sign's proper face, and كَانُوا makes that refusal a sustained practice rather than a single mistake.

activation_trace.role: Turning something from its proper face supplies the directional reversal enacted by the passive verb.
A visible marker supplies the orientation that can be recognized and followed.
Denial despite knowledge makes the reversal a contradiction of recognized truth rather than simple ignorance.
Occurrence through time makes denial a sustained past practice feeding the present analogy.

changed_reading.before: They are merely mistaken about God's proofs.
changed_reading.after: Those who repeatedly negate recognized waymarks undergo a passive reorientation away from the face those marks indicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The falsehood branch of ء ف ك converges with ج ح د as outward denial of what is inwardly known.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing refusal turns a truthful account into its contrary. The same root that describes truth diverted into falsehood then describes the deniers themselves as diverted, allowing an action-and-recoil reading inside the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood as speech diverted from truth supplies the deniers' inverted account.
Knowledge retained inwardly makes the outward contrary an active inversion.
Repeated temporal occurrence lets the inversion become an established mode.

changed_reading.before: They deny and are then independently turned aside.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated conversion of recognized truth into its contrary becomes the very pattern in which they are themselves turned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rain-deprived land branch of ء ف ك and the scarcity branch of ج ح د coexist with آيات as visible marks.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two focus roots independently open onto failed fertility: rain is diverted from land, and good, rain, or growth becomes scarce. This permits a material model in which denial is a failure of reception, leaving a sign-bearing field unwatered and unfruitful.

activation_trace.role: Land deprived because rain is diverted supplies the receiving surface made barren.
Scarcity of good, rain, and growth supplies the resulting constriction and infertility.
Visible marks are the material that should have made the receiving field legible and responsive.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only the rejection of propositions.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be imaged as barren reception: signs remain visible, but the capacity that should receive and grow from them is deprived of its rain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah depicts a counter-sign technology: dispute twists, glitter deceives, falsehood tries to make truth lose its footing, embellished action blocks the path, and followers inherit the supplied orientation. The later passive ص ر ف restates the resulting diversion, so the focus passive can include socially mediated rerouting without erasing personal or divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Directional reversal anchors every contextual operation back in the focus passive.
Visible signs are the genuine orientation against which counter-signs operate.
Twisted contention supplies the discursive operation that wraps around the signs.
A gleaming but unstable deception supplies attractive false visibility.
Loss of footing supplies the attempted displacement of truth by false argument.
Making an act appear beautiful supplies the manufacture of an appealing rival orientation.
Active obstruction and turning away supplies the path-blocking result.
Following behind supplies the social transmission of the imposed route.
Being sent back from a face directly echoes and confirms the focus's passive diversion.

structural_cues: Dispute over God's signs recurs at 40:4, 40:35, 40:56, and 40:69.
40:5 pairs falsehood with an attempt to dislodge truth, while 40:37 pairs beautification with obstruction from the path.
40:69 restates the focus pattern with a passive directional verb immediately after sign-disputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies twisted dispute, deceptive shine, lost footing, beautification, blockage, following, and later diversion; I infer a social-discursive chain that installs a rival orientation. Personal self-deception and divine judicial turning remain live alternatives rather than being replaced.

changed_reading.before: The turning is a private cognitive error affecting isolated deniers.
changed_reading.after: The turning can be produced through public counter-signs: persuasive distortion dislodges truth, blocks its route, and is socially followed until the deniers themselves are rerouted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated travel, directed looking, surviving traces, guidance, path, and diversion turn آيات into waymarks in a navigable historical landscape. Denial removes usable orientation: one can move through the terrain and see its traces yet still be turned from the route they indicate.

activation_trace.role: The visible marker anchors the navigational function of signs.
Turning from a proper direction supplies the route failure named in the focus.
Movement through the land supplies the traveler who must orient from encountered evidence.
Directed sight and insight supply the act of reading the route.
A surviving mark that indicates what occurred supplies historical waypoints.
Gentle indication toward the true road supplies active guidance.
An extended traversable path supplies the course that signs and guidance identify.
Diversion from a face supplies the terminal loss of orientation.

structural_cues: The paired command to travel the earth and look at predecessors' outcome occurs at both 40:21 and 40:82.
The believing man's counterclaim at 40:38 explicitly joins guidance to a path.
40:69 places sign-disputation beside a passive question of diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, directed looking, residual marks, path, guidance, and diversion; I infer that signs function as route markers across space and history. They may alternatively remain evidentiary signs without a fully spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The signs are abstract propositions that deniers fail to assent to.
changed_reading.after: The signs are also waymarks: denial is a navigational failure in which visible traces no longer orient conduct, so the traveler is turned off the indicated road.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated refusal is accumulated, requited, and stamped. A due consequence, repayment for acquisition, and the imprinting of a heart make the focus passive read as ratification of practiced denial rather than an unexplained deprivation of access.

activation_trace.role: Knowing denial supplies the accountable practice being ratified.
Sustained occurrence through time supplies accumulation rather than a single offense.
A fixed obligation becoming due supplies the consequence that now attaches.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the response structure.
What is acquired by pursuit supplies the deniers' own contribution to the resulting state.
A seal that fixes an image supplies the finalization of a repeatedly enacted disposition.

structural_cues: كَذَٰلِكَ introduces both the due word at 40:6 and the heart-imprint at 40:35 before the focus refrain at 40:63.
40:17 states recompense by what each self acquired, while the focus places passive turning after habitual denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a due consequence, acquired action, matching recompense, and a fixed imprint; I infer a juridical sequence from repeated refusal to ratified orientation. The repeated formulas may instead be analogical refrains without a strict procedural chain.

changed_reading.before: They are arbitrarily turned before or apart from their denial.
changed_reading.after: Their passive turning reads like a verdict-imprint: a repeatedly acquired knowing refusal is fixed into the orientation it has practiced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens hidden interiors to inspection and contrasts inner blindness with insight before ending with a verb of nonrecognition. These cues sharpen ج ح د as managed mismatch: disclosed or inwardly available knowledge is kept from becoming acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Denial of what is known anchors the gap between inward recognition and outward refusal.
Visible marks make the object of denial available rather than absent.
Disclosure to a knower supplies epistemic exposure.
Concealment supplies the hidden layer that outward conduct can contradict.
The interior as the source from which acts issue supplies a route from hidden state to public denial.
Blindness of insight supplies a condition deeper than unavailable visual data.
Insight of the heart supplies the live alternative capacity.
The contrary of recognition and admission restates denial as refused acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 40:19 places divine knowledge beside what eyes betray and chests hide.
40:58 formally opposes the blind and the seeing before saying remembrance is rare.
40:81 asks which displayed signs are being disowned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden interiors, disclosure, heart-blindness, insight, and nonrecognition; I infer continuity from available recognition to controlled refusal. The verses may address different groups, so the sequence need not describe one individual's psychology.

changed_reading.before: The deniers lack the information needed to recognize the signs.
changed_reading.after: The deniers manage an exposed contradiction: signs are available and inward recognition remains possible, but acknowledgment is suppressed until the contradiction itself becomes disorientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet directly co-locates shown signs, provision delivered from the sky, remembering, and returning. That sequence activates the focus's rain-deprived land and scarcity branches: signs are provision offered to a receiving ground, while return reopens reception and habitual denial leaves it barren.

activation_trace.role: Rain diverted from land anchors the image of failed reception.
Scarcity of good, rain, and growth supplies the barren result.
Shown marks tie the material provision sequence back to the focus signs.
Delivery downward supplies provision moving toward a receiver.
Rain descending as provision makes the nourishment mechanism explicit.
Habitual return supplies the receptive countermovement to being turned away.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the fruitful receiver denied by the focus's barren branch.

structural_cues: 40:13 co-locates displayed signs, provision sent from the sky, remembrance, and return.
40:61-64 surround the focus with night and day visibility, unthanked bounty, settled earth, built sky, embodied form, and good provision.
40:79-81 close with animals, riding, eating, benefits, needs, and displayed signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs beside descending provision and return, then a provision-rich material surround; I infer a soil-and-rain model of reception. These may instead be adjacent examples of power and generosity rather than one sustained ecological metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is only movement from an argument.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is also failed nourishment: habitual denial leaves the sign-receiving ground barren, while return would let the descending provision take root.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, repeated كَانُوا constructions attach durable conduct to eventual enclosure: exulting, swaggering, and mocking persist as temporal profiles until what was mocked closes around the actors. The closing appeal to an established course makes the focus's كَانُوا a transhistorical habit-pattern.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence through past time anchors denial as an enacted duration.
Repeated being-in-time binds two ongoing behaviors into a durable profile.
Overweening delight supplies one repeatedly inhabited behavior.
Past persistence connects mockery to the consequence that later surrounds it.
Mockery supplies the repeated stance whose object returns as consequence.
A running, followed course supplies the transhistorical regularity of the pattern.

structural_cues: 40:75 repeats كُنتُمْ for exulting and swaggering.
40:83 says that what they had habitually mocked closed around them.
40:85 names an established course that has already passed among servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated past-state constructions, persistent behaviors, enveloping consequence, and an established course; I infer habituation as the temporal bridge to passive turning. The forms can also function as ordinary past description without implying psychological hardening.

changed_reading.before: كَانُوا merely locates denial at a past moment.
changed_reading.after: كَانُوا marks a repeatedly inhabited orientation: denial hardens through duration, and يُؤْفَكُ names where that durable practice has brought its practitioners.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows material container branches rather than the ordinary abstract sense of denial. It remains anchored in the focus through ج ح د's full-vessel branch beside its knowing-denial branch, and context supplies a throat, closure after fullness, a terminal seal, and bonds at the neck. Downstream prose should present it only as an analogy of suppressed acknowledgment, not as the lexical meaning of يَجْحَدُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ج ح د carries both knowing denial and an image of a filled vessel; the focus can therefore be tested as recognition held under pressure rather than absent content.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge inwardly retained supplies the content being prevented from becoming admission.
A filled skin or sack supplies the pressurized container image.
The throat supplies the narrowed outlet between interior state and voiced admission.
Closing an opening after fullness supplies containment under pressure.
Fullness to the limit supplies the terminal saturation of the interior.
A collar constraining an organ externalizes the inward blockage.
The neck locates the later bodily manifestation of constricted acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Denial reflects an empty interior with no recognized truth present.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is an overfull but sealed interior: recognized truth is held below the throat until the practiced blockage becomes a fixed and externally manifest constraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant س م و to و س م mapping, where first rain marks earth through vegetation. It remains valid because 40:13 itself joins sky, displayed signs, descending rain-provision, and return, while the focus supplies visible marks and rain-diverted land. Downstream prose should label this a split-root material activation, not claim that السماء ordinarily means inscription.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: آيات as visible marks and ء ف ك as land deprived of rain permit the world itself to be read as a rain-inscribed sign surface.

activation_trace.role: Visible marks anchor the reading in the focus's sign language.
Rain diverted from land supplies the erased or unrealized sign surface.
First rain marking earth through growth supplies material inscription from the sky cue.
Rain as descending provision supplies the medium of that inscription.
Soft growth-bearing earth supplies the surface on which the mark becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Signs are discrete statements set before an observer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, signs are rain-written growth across a receptive world; being turned away is failure to read the material inscription and failure to receive what writes it.

strongest_changes: The passive turning becomes an accumulated, verdict-like ratification of knowing denial rather than an unexplained loss of access.
Signs shift from abstract proofs to route markers contested by twisted, attractive, and socially transmitted counter-signs.
The sky-provision sequence activates a material ecology in which denial is barrenness and failed reception.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made directional, juridical, epistemic, and ecological mechanisms coexist. Especially productive was the exact pairing of the focus's drought branches with 40:13's signs, sky-sent provision, remembrance, and return, plus the packet's split sky-to-mark branch.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive agent remains underdetermined: divine judicial turning, self-habituation, and social mediation can coexist.
The ecological, vessel-pressure, and rain-inscription readings are material analogies and should not displace the ordinary directional and epistemic senses.
Contextual sequences may address different groups, so not every mechanism must describe one continuous individual psychology.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Knowing denial produces directional reversal.** `ج ح د/B001` gives denial of what is known true; `ء ف ك/B001` gives diversion from proper direction. The passive reversal is explained by habitual denial. I infer that suppressing acknowledged evidence repeatedly reorients the perceiver; the ayah reads being turned away as the formed consequence of knowing refusal.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The sign-inspection question of 40:81 and late seeing of 40:84 show two endpoints of denial: recognition can be refused until overwhelming force replaces ordinary signs.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Knowing denial supplies the resistance expressed as turning.** Lexically, `ج ح د:B001` is "knowing denial" and `ء ف ك:B001` turning away from proper direction; `ء ي ي:B003` is a visible sign. Structurally, visible temporal provision in 40:61 and universal making in 40:62 precede this causal-style juxtaposition, while 40:64 adds more inhabitable signs. Denial's role is not lack of access but resistance to markers already apprehended; turning names its directional result. The packet supplies the two predicates but does not state their arrow; I infer that knowingly refusing signs enables or manifests the misorientation. The ayah consequently sharpens `يؤفك` from unexplained diversion into a pattern attached to practiced denial.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:81 explicitly asks which visible signs are denied, and 40:83 shows a closed knowledge-system rejecting new demonstrations; both confirm active estrangement rather than failed access.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi tersine çevirip olması gereken yönünden uzaklaştırmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Bir kimseyi bir işten, iyilikten, inançtan veya doğrudan yalan ve batıl aracılığıyla uzaklaştırma bu çekirdeğin kişi ve amaç alanındaki özelleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalanın kendisini değil, bir şeyin ya da kişinin yönünden çevrilmesi işlemini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel çevirme çekirdeğini korur; birini belirli bir şeyden uzaklaştırma anlamını ise yalnızca ilgili yapıya bağlı bir özelleşme olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tersine çevirerek olması gereken yönünden uzaklaştırmak veya başka bir yöne sevk etmektir. Kişi nesne olduğunda, onu bir amaçtan, iyilikten, inançtan ya da doğrudan alıkoyup batıla yöneltmeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir şey tersine çevrilir ve ait olduğu ya da yönelmesi gereken doğrultudan uzaklaştırılır.
Kişiye yönelik kullanımda kişi bir amaçtan, iyilikten, inançtan veya doğrudan alıkonup başka yöne sevk edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, tersine çevirme ile doğru ya da beklenen yönden uzaklaştırmayı birleştirir; kişiyi doğrudan veya iyilikten yalan ve batılla uzaklaştırma bunun özel görünümüdür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem nesnenin yönünü tersine çevirme çekirdeğini hem de kişinin amaç veya doğrultusundan uzaklaştırılmasını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tersine çevirme işlemini, yön değişikliğini ve hedeflenen doğrultudan uzaklaştırmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin veya işin beklenen doğrultusundan çevrilmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi kendi yönünden uzaklaştırma işlemini bağlam içinde tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın hakikatten, inançtan veya iyilikten uzaklaştırıldığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin doğru kabul edilen amaç veya doğrultudan uzaklaştırılması özelleşmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi tersine çevirip yönünden saptırmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, nesneyi tersine çevirmeyi ve kişiyi bir amaçtan etkin biçimde uzaklaştırmayı birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, öznenin yoldan veya doğrudan kendiliğinden sapmasını ve eğriliği de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da doğru veya beklenen yönden uzaklaşma ve uzaklaştırma alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda başka bir şeyi çeviren ya da saptıran bir etki öne çıkar; komşu dalda ise genel yön değişmesi, yoldan sapma ve eğrilik daha geniş bir alan oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, insanı hakikatten, inançtan veya iyilikten uzaklaştırma özelleşmesine sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, fiziksel bükme ve burma işlemlerini ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesne, yüz, kişi veya düşünceyi bulunduğu yönden çevirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırt edici yanı tersine çevirme ve amaçtan saptırmadır; komşu dalın ayırt edici yanı ise bükme ve burma hareketidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça yalan ve günah alanında kurar, fakat bu yalanı doğruluktan çevrilmiş söz olarak kavramsallaştırır. Yalan söyleyen kişi, büyük yalan ve insanları batılla doğrudan uzaklaştıran yalancı aynı dalın türemiş görünümleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal her türlü yön değiştirmeyi değil, doğruluktan ayrılan yalanı ve onun kişi adlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalan çekirdeği ile yalan söyleme, büyük yalan ve saptırıcı yalancı bildiren türemiş biçimler ayrı yönleriyle korunur.

concept_map.definition: Doğruluktan çevrilmiş yalanı ve bu niteliğiyle günahı anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda yalan söylemeyi, büyük bir yalanı ve insanları yalanla doğrudan uzaklaştıran yalancıyı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Söz doğruluktan ayrılmıştır ve bu nedenle yalan veya günah niteliği taşır.
Türemiş biçimler yalan söyleme eylemini, büyük yalanı ve yalanla başkalarını doğrudan saptıran kişiyi adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yalan anlamında birleşir; toplu ifade ayrıca günahı, büyük yalanı ve insanları batılla doğrudan uzaklaştıran sürekli yalancıyı aynı anlam ailesinde gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın doğruluktan ayrılma tasarımını, yalan çekirdeğini ve bunun günah sayılan niteliğini birlikte belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluktan ayrılmayı, yalan içeriğini ve günah niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün doğruluğa aykırı oluşunun öne çıktığı genel bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluktan ayrılmış sözün yalan olma niteliğini bağlam içinde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalancının yalnız yalan söylemeyip başkalarını doğrudan uzaklaştırdığı kişi bağlamlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yalan söyleyen kişinin batıl yoluyla başkalarını doğrudan uzaklaştırmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yalanı doğruluktan çevrilme ve insanları batılla doğrudan uzaklaştırma tasarımıyla ilişkilendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yalanı sözün yanı sıra eylem alanında da genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğruluğa aykırı söz ve yalancı kişi alanında doğrudan kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalanın genel adıdır; odak dal ise yalanı doğruluktan sapmış ve başkasını da doğrudan uzaklaştırabilen bir içerik olarak belirginleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal günah niteliğini, büyük yalanı ve yalanla başkalarını doğrudan uzaklaştırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, doğrulanmamış zanla veya kesin bilgi olmadan konuşmayı da yalan alanına dahil eder.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da gerçekliğe aykırı veya dayanaksız söz söyleme bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluktan çevrilmiş yalan üzerinde durur; komşu dalın özel sınırı ise kesin bilgi bulunmadan zanla söz söylemeye kadar uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yalan ve bilgiye dayanmayan asılsız sözle kurulan iki ayrım dal sınırını yeterince gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإفك والكذب والأفيكة والكذبة العظيمة والأفاك الكذاب ومن يأفك الناس بالباطل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل صرف عن جهة ولا انقلاب الأرض ولا الرياح المؤتفكات
branches.source_phrase_ar: أفك الرجل إذا كذب والإفك الكذب (maqayis)؛ الإفك الكذب والأفاك الذي يأفك الناس عن الحق (ayn)؛ الإفك الكذب والأفيكة ورجل أفاك أي كذاب (sihah)؛ الإفك الإثم والإفك الكذب ويا للأفيكة وهي الكذبة العظيمة (tahdhib)؛ من الصدق في المقال إلى الكذب واستعمل ذلك في الكذب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir beldenin halkıyla birlikte ters çevrilmesini ve böyle yok edilmiş kentleri açıkça destekler. Bununla birlikte adlaşmış çoğul biçim yalnız toprağı değil, geçmişte sapmış ve yok edilmiş toplulukları da gösterebildiğinden geçici çerçevedeki toprak vurgusu tek başına yeterli değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ters çevrilen yer olayı çekirdektir; adlaşmış kullanım yok edilmiş kentleri veya toplulukları da gösterebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerleşimin halkıyla ters çevrilmesi yapısını ve bunun sonucunu adlandıran çoğul biçimi ayırarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerleşimin veya toprağın halkıyla birlikte ters çevrilip yıkıma uğramasıdır. Adlaşmış kullanımda böyle ters çevrilerek yok edilmiş kentleri ya da geçmiş toplulukları gösterir.

facets.statement: Yerleşim veya toprak, üzerindeki halkla birlikte ters çevrilerek yıkıma uğrar.
Adlaşmış çoğul kullanım, bu biçimde yok edilmiş kentleri veya geçmişte sapmış toplulukları gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi halkıyla birlikte ters çevrilen yer olayını ve bu yolla yok edilmiş kent ya da toplulukların adlandırılmasını bir araya getirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı tutarlı biçimde rüzgarların esiş yönlerinin farklılaşmasına veya olağan yönlerinden sapmasına bağlar. Yerleşimlerin ters çevrilmesiyle biçimsel bağ bulunsa da burada gönderge ve koşul yalnız rüzgardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yağmur almayan toprağın kuruyup bitkisiz kalmasını ve daha ileri bir anlatımda kuraklıktan kavrulmasını açıkça destekler. Her iki görünüm de belirli toprak yapılarıyla sınırlıdır.

facets.statement: Toprak yağmur almamış, bunun sonucunda kurumuş ve bitkisiz kalmıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aklın sağlıklı işleyişinden çevrilmesini, akıl ve görüş zayıflığını, ayrıca tedbir ve çare yoksunluğunu aynı dalda toplar. Bunlar yalanın kendisi değil, kişinin muhakeme ve karar verme yetisinin bozulmuş durumudur.
